outcome: Use research and exploration, including study of different cultures, to find and understand what users need.
Identify their own design problems and know how to reformulate problems they are given.
Write specifications that guide innovative, functional, appealing products meeting needs in varied situations.
Use varied approaches, such as biomimicry and user-centred design, to generate creative ideas and avoid stereotypes.
Develop and communicate ideas using annotated sketches, detailed plans, 3-D and mathematical models, presentations and computer tools.
Select and precisely use specialist tools, techniques, processes, equipment and machinery, including computer-aided manufacture.
Choose and use a wider, more complex range of materials, components and ingredients according to their properties.
Analyse the work of past and present professionals and others to broaden understanding.
Test, evaluate and refine ideas and products against a specification, considering the views of users and other groups.
Understand how design and technology affects individuals, society and the environment, and what responsibilities designers, engineers and technologists have.
Understand and use material properties and the performance of structural elements to make working solutions.
Explain how advanced mechanical systems in products change movement and force.
Explain how advanced electrical and electronic systems are powered and used in products, such as circuits with heat, light, sound and movement inputs and outputs.
Use computing and electronics to build intelligence into products, using sensors for inputs and actuators for outputs with programmable components such as microcontrollers.
Understand and apply the principles of nutrition and health.
Cook a repertoire of mainly savoury dishes to feed themselves and others a healthy, varied diet.
Become competent in cooking techniques such as preparing ingredients, using equipment, applying heat, seasoning by taste and smell, and adapting recipes.
Understand the source, seasonality and characteristics of a broad range of ingredients.
